label: ProLiant ML350 Gen10 tower server
description: Tower two-socket server with four embedded 1GbE ports (HPE 369i) and a 1GbE dedicated iLO 5 port. There is no FlexibleLOM bay; extra NICs go in the PCIe stand-up slots.
notes: Onboard: 4x 1GbE 369i standard. No FlexibleLOM - a 10GbE upgrade is a PCIe stand-up adapter. iLO 5 dedicated 1GbE port plus a front iLO service port (USB, not Ethernet - not modelled).
